## 1. Definitions

"User" or "you" denotes the individual or entity that creates an account to access and utilize the CloudSync services. "Content" encompasses any data, files, documents, or information that you upload, store, or generate within the CloudSync platform.

"Service" describes the functionality, features, and tools made available to you through the CloudSync platform, such as file synchronization, cloud storage, and collaborative editing capabilities. "Subscription" refers to the specific plan you have selected, which dictates the storage limits, feature access, and billing cycle applicable to your account. "Third-Party Services" are external applications or platforms that you may integrate with CloudSync, which are governed by their own separate terms and privacy policies.

Continued use of the Service after any changes to these definitions or terms constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

You are responsible for ensuring that your payment method is valid and has sufficient funds or credit available to cover the subscription fees. If a payment fails, we will notify you and attempt to charge your payment method again. If the payment remains unsuccessful after a grace period of ten (10) days, we reserve the right to suspend your access to the Service until the outstanding balance is paid. In cases of prolonged non-payment, we may terminate your account and delete your Content in accordance with our termination policy.

Prices for CloudSync subscriptions are subject to change at our sole discretion. We will provide you with at least thirty (30) days' notice of any price increase before it takes effect. If you do not agree with the new pricing, you may cancel your subscription before the price increase becomes effective.
